name: Cahya Mata Sarawak Berhad
summary: Cahya Mata Sarawak Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and trading of cement and construction materials in Malaysia and internationally. The company operates through Cement, Property Development, Oiltools, Phosphate, Road Maintenance, Environmental Technology, and Diversified strategic Business Units segments. It is involved in manufacturing clinker, cement, ready mix, and precast concrete; quarrying, premix manufacturing, trading and logistics, supplies aggregates, asphalt premix, wire mesh, and other related materials; and development of feedstock for industrial and agricultural applications.
